title: 第27章 柳醉梅求治
novel_title: 觉醒阴阳神功：分手后我爽麻了
content_zh:
陈阳心中暗自冷笑：这个黄金龙，倒是打得一手好算盘，刚一来就给我安排这么一位“极品助手”，分明就是想监视我，甚至想色诱我。

    不过，这女人虽然有点心机，但长得确实养眼，带在身边也不算麻烦。

    他淡淡开口：“行，那就一块吧。”

    姜小媚脸上瞬间露出开心的笑容，连忙点头：“好嘞，陈主管！”

    说着，就快步跟上陈阳的脚步，眼神里闪过一丝得意。

    她就不信，两人长期相处下来，还拿不下他。

    两人穿过走廊，走进电梯。

    姜小媚看着陈阳按下一楼的按钮，脸上露出几分疑惑，忍不住问：“陈主管，现在还没有到下班时间呢。”

    陈阳淡淡瞥了她一眼，语气平淡：“知道。”

    姜小媚又追问：“不知陈主管要去哪？要是有工作上的事，我可以帮您打下手的。”

    陈阳语气依旧冷淡：“到外面随便转转。”

    姜小媚咬了咬嘴唇，壮着胆子说：“陈主管，公司有规定，上班时间要是没有特殊情况，是不能随便离开公司的，不然……”

    陈阳抬眸，冷冷地看了她一眼，眼神里带着一丝威慑。

    姜小媚被他看得浑身一僵，连忙闭上嘴，再也不敢多言。

    很快，电梯下到一楼，门缓缓打开。

    陈阳看了姜小媚一眼，语气冷淡说：“你要是怕事，就不要跟来。”

    说完，他直接转身走出了电梯。

    姜小媚连忙跟上，连忙说：“我才不怕！我是您的助手，自然要跟着您，帮您处理事情。”

    她跟在陈阳身后，心中暗自思忖：出了事有黄总给我兜底，我有什么好怕的？

    只要能拿下你，完成黄总交代的任务，到时候好处少不了我的！

    陈阳穿过一楼大堂走出，刚踏入门口的阴影处，就见台阶下站着三个熟悉的身影。

    正是他刚开除的那三名项目部组长。

    三人双手抱胸，面色阴鸷，眼神凶狠地盯着他，眼底的怒火几乎要溢出来，显然是特意在这里堵他，想报被开除的仇。

    ……

    与此同时，苏氏集团顶楼的总裁办公室内。
content_en:
Chen Yang sneered secretly in his heart: This golden dragon is really good at calculating. He arranged such a "best assistant" for me as soon as he arrived. He clearly wanted to spy on me and even wanted to seduce me.

However, although this woman is a bit scheming, she is really eye-catching, and it is not troublesome to keep her around.

He said calmly: "Okay, let's take one piece."

A happy smile instantly appeared on Jiang Xiaomei's face, and she nodded quickly: "Okay, Manager Chen!"

After saying that, he quickly followed Chen Yang's footsteps, a trace of pride flashed in his eyes.

She didn't believe it. After two people had been together for a long time, they still couldn't defeat him.

The two walked through the corridor and entered the elevator.

Jiang Xiaomei watched Chen Yang press the button on the first floor with a bit of confusion on her face. She couldn't help but ask: "Director Chen, it's not time to get off work yet."

Chen Yang glanced at her lightly and said calmly: "I know."

Jiang Xiaomei asked again: "I wonder where Director Chen is going? If there is something work-related, I can help you."

Chen Yang's tone was still cold: "Go outside and walk around casually."

Jiang Xiaomei bit her lip and bravely said: "Director Chen, the company has regulations. Unless there are special circumstances during working hours, you cannot leave the company casually, otherwise..."

Chen Yang raised his eyes and glanced at her coldly, with a hint of intimidation in his eyes.

Jiang Xiaomei froze at the sight of him and quickly shut her mouth, not daring to say anything more.

Soon, the elevator went down to the first floor and the door slowly opened.

Chen Yang glanced at Jiang Xiaomei and said in a cold tone: "If you are afraid of trouble, don't follow me."

After saying that, he turned around and walked out of the elevator.

Jiang Xiaomei hurriedly followed and said: "I'm not afraid! I am your assistant, so naturally I will follow you and help you handle things."

She followed Chen Yang, thinking to herself: Mr. Huang will take care of me if something goes wrong, so what do I have to be afraid of?

As long as I can capture you and complete the tasks assigned by Mr. Huang, the benefits will be mine!

Chen Yang walked out through the lobby on the first floor. As soon as he stepped into the shadow of the door, he saw three familiar figures standing at the foot of the steps.

It was the three project department leaders he had just fired.

The three of them crossed their arms, looked sinister, and stared at him fiercely. The anger in their eyes almost overflowed. It was obvious that they were trying to block him here and wanted to avenge their expulsion.

…

At the same time, in the president's office on the top floor of the Su Group.
